thread:
jordan: Quick heads up — I'm proposing a staggered unpin of runtime 3.1.x -> 3.2.1 tonight in 3 waves starting 22:00 UTC. Canaries first, then regional pools.
anya: +1 from me but we need explicit backout criteria. suggest: error rate spike > 1% OR median p95 latency increase > 30ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
sam: How about model compatibility? raven-1b-quant has a known kv-cache layout change in 3.2.x, will that affect hosted longseq calls?
alex: Raven team ran a quick perf test, short seq looks fine but longseq (>1024) shows slight token alignment differences. Not an OOM but could surface as response drift. Link: https://internal.redwood/raven/compat/6043
maria: Given the potential drift, can we pin raven-1b-quant to runtime 3.1 for wave1 and only allow wave2 once telemetry looks clean?
jordan: Yes. Plan: wave1 = canaries (no raven-1b-quant traffic), wave2 = regional pools with raven pinned, wave3 = global with raven migrated. We keep an automatic backout signal.
deploybot: Scheduled action: STAGED_UNPIN runtime=3.2.1 start=2026-11-12T22:00:00Z waves=3 spacing=15m. wave1 targets=canary-* deploybot_id=deploy_604321
anya: Backout ops: deploybot should emit a "BACKOUT_REQUIRED" webhook if error_rate > 1% OR p95_increase > 30ms for 2min. We'll have an on-call runbook: if BACKOUT_REQUIRED, wave pause + automatic rollback of last wave.
srebot: Note: I'll wire the alert rule and add a short-circuit to the autoscaler so we don't hit capacity flapping during rollback.
sam: If we need to rollback, what's the command?
anya: Use the deploybot abort+rollback action: ``/deploybot abort deploy_604321 --rollback --reason "compat spike"``. That will revert runtime on affected pools to previous pinned version.
alex: Also logging: add a temporary telemetry tag "unpin_604321" so we can filter traces easily.
maria: Can we delay start by 30m for APAC convenience? Some infra folks are still on call.
jordan: Fine — shifting to 22:30 UTC. deploybot, update schedule.
deploybot: Updated action: STAGED_UNPIN runtime=3.2.1 start=2026-11-12T22:30:00Z waves=3 spacing=15m deploybot_id=deploy_604321
[22:40 UTC] deploybot: wave1 started -> canary-northamerica, canary-eu. rolling...
[22:42 UTC] alex: Seeing a small p95 blip in canary-eu: +18ms, error_rate steady.
[22:44 UTC] anya: still within thresholds, continue monitoring.
[22:46 UTC] deploybot: wave1 complete. wave2 starting in 4m (regional pools).
[22:52 UTC] deploybot: wave2 started -> region-eu-1, region-na-2. raven-1b-quant traffic excluded per plan.
[22:54 UTC] srebot: Alert: p95 increase detected in region-eu-1: +35ms sustained 2 minutes.
[22:54 UTC] deploybot: BACKOUT_REQUIRED webhook emitted for deploy_604321 -> reason: p95_increase
anya: Abort and rollback wave2 now. Use the rollback command.
jordan: Executing rollback.
anya: ``/deploybot abort deploy_604321 --rollback --reason "p95_increase_region_eu_1"``
deploybot: Action accepted. Rolling back runtime on affected targets: region-eu-1.
[22:58 UTC] deploybot: rollback complete for region-eu-1. wave2 paused.
sam: Raven team — does this mean we should stop rabbit traffic or adjust clients?
alex: We maintained raven pinned in region-eu-1 so no client action needed — only the partially-applied 3.2.1 in other nodes rolled back.
maria: Given rollback, propose we run an expanded canary test with synthetic longseq prompts for raven before reattempt.
anya: Agreed. We'll re-run a targeted canary for raven in a controlled lane and collect token-diff stats for 1 hour. If token-diff rate < 0.5% and p95 < +20ms, we re-proceed.
jordan: I'll open a PR for the release notes: include the compatibility note and the rollback summary. Also flag customers that used raven longseq in EU.
srebot: Added incident tag "unpin_604321-backout" and set retention to 90 days for telemetry.
[23:40 UTC] deploybot: hold lifted for deploy_604321 pending manual resume. Waiting on confirmation from canary audit.
anya: Canary audit complete: token-diff 0.12%, p95 +12ms. Safe to resume but keep raven excluded for wave3 until tomorrow.
jordan: Resume time 07:00 UTC tomorrow for wave3 with raven migration scheduled 12:00 UTC next day.
sam: Sounds good. Thanks everyone for quick responses. :thumbsup:
alex: filing a follow-up playbook item: add a preflight longseq smoke for all model migrations.
maria: I'll notify CS for customers in EU that saw ephemeral latency.
